data.name: Nothing - the Video Game
data.detailed_description: It is literally nothing. This is the point of the game. You open it and there is nothing. You play it and there is nothing you can do, no matter how hard you try. You are signing up for what you are getting here: Nothing. Because at this point we would rather play NOTHING than what most of these American AAA game studios are putting out. It is a protest vote as much as it is a game.
